title: Adding honey supers to our boxes.
description:
www.studiobeeproductions.com
It's been almost 7 weeks since I split our hives here at the abbey, as well as in all our other out yards. Yet, when I made our splits, not every hive had developed enough bees to make a successful split, so I left them alone. Now, almost 7 weeks later, those hives now have 2 full boxes of bees, and there is a real possibility of the hive swarming. As my main intent of keeping bees is for the production of honey for the Abbey Gift Shop, swarm prevention is a must. My solution, add another deep super and give the girls a lot of extra space.

By frame manipulation, my hope is to give the hive bees lots of work to do other than making swarm cells, and by adding an empty box, the available space for the expansion of the hive has now increased by 50%. This added area, along with all the work that will be necessary to fill it, greatly decreases the odds of our old queen swarming. If the bees figure there's enough room in the hive, they may stay and give us a great honey harvest. Of course, I'm asking the monks to do some praying about that situation as well. Just another little something to increase our possibilities of a successful harvest. 

Our Swarm Catch Challenge is really taking off, and the number of folks sending in their pictures is getting larger. If you'd like to participate in the Challenge yourself, and I'd love for you to do so, simply send me your picture of your swarm catch, with your face in the shot, and I will get it on a video. Remember, by sending me your photo, you are giving me permission to post it on my video. You can send the photo to    oscelata@gmail.com    and I will respond. For all who have already sent their photos, thank you very much. God's peace to all.
Mr. Ed


Song used for swarm catches is titled " Avocado Street," and can be found on Youtube's audio library.
author: Jeff Horchoff Bees
